steps.note: THE REPORTED CASE (2026-08-30): a page sitting on a console that is then switched off, with the reader having changed NOTHING. Two things were wrong and both are here. The give-up counted failed PUSHES, and an idle page pushes nothing -- so the counter never advanced and the notice took over a minute. And when it came it carried the data-loss warning, telling someone who had changed nothing that their work was at risk.

No clicks. No edits. Nothing is polled because nothing is pending -- which is the whole point: only the heartbeat can notice, and 15s of silence is the budget. The harness kills the board during this wait.
